active_checkout.expected_head_rule: After fetch and fast-forward update, local HEAD must equal origin/agent/ai-actors-control-panel.
active_checkout.expected_base_rule: origin/agent/lan-mode must be an ancestor of local HEAD.

github_snapshot.note: GitHub reported no commit status contexts for the observed PR head. Local repository checks and live validation remain required.

last_verified_checkout.note: This SHA is a historical verified checkout. Later documentation commits advance the branch head; always fetch the expected head ref before beginning work.

local_checks.command: git rev-parse HEAD && git rev-parse origin/agent/ai-actors-control-panel

dependency_install_policy.reason: Install exactly from package-lock.json without an incidental lockfile rewrite.
dependency_install_policy.audit_rule: Do not run npm audit fix automatically during checkout verification because it may change dependency versions and package-lock.json.

sha_policy.source_of_truth: The fetched remote tracking ref origin/agent/ai-actors-control-panel.
sha_policy.rule: Do not treat a SHA written inside this repository as permanently current because the commit that updates the record creates a new head SHA.
sha_policy.handoff_rule: Every work handoff must report the exact current remote head SHA after all commits are complete.

safety.update_mode: Use git pull --ff-only so an update cannot silently create a merge commit.
safety.dirty_checkout: Commit, stash, or intentionally discard local changes before updating. Do not use git reset --hard unless the work is backed up and the destructive action is deliberate.
